from sqlalchemy import text
import pandas as pd

# Query hourly AQHI data for station 15 from 2025-01-20 to 2025-01-26
# Time window: 2025-01-20 00:00:00 to 2025-01-27 00:00:00 (exclusive end)
query = text("""
SELECT datetime, aqhi
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE station_id = 15
AND datetime >= '2025-01-20 00:00:00'
AND datetime < '2025-01-27 00:00:00'
ORDER BY datetime
""")

df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(f"Total rows fetched: {len(df)}")
print(df.head(10))
print(f"\nDate range: {df['datetime'].min()} to {df['datetime'].max()}")

# Compute weekday mean (2025-01-20 to 2025-01-24)
weekday_mask = (df['datetime'] >= '2025-01-20 00:00:00') & (df['datetime'] < '2025-01-25 00:00:00')
weekday_data = df[weekday_mask]
weekday_mean_aqhi = float(weekday_data['aqhi'].mean()) if len(weekday_data) > 0 else None
print(f"\nWeekday rows (Jan 20-24): {len(weekday_data)}")
print(f"Weekday mean AQHI: {weekday_mean_aqhi}")

# Compute weekend mean (2025-01-25 to 2025-01-26)
weekend_mask = (df['datetime'] >= '2025-01-25 00:00:00') & (df['datetime'] < '2025-01-27 00:00:00')
weekend_data = df[weekend_mask]
weekend_mean_aqhi = float(weekend_data['aqhi'].mean()) if len(weekend_data) > 0 else None
print(f"Weekend rows (Jan 25-26): {len(weekend_data)}")
print(f"Weekend mean AQHI: {weekend_mean_aqhi}")

# Assign to shared runtime variables
weekday_mean_aqhi = weekday_mean_aqhi
weekend_mean_aqhi = weekend_mean_aqhi

# Compute mean hourly AQHI for weekday period (Jan 20-24) and weekend period (Jan 25-26) at station 15

# Weekday period: 2025-01-20 00:00 to 2025-01-25 00:00 (exclusive)
weekday_query = """
SELECT AVG(aqhi) as avg_aqhi, COUNT(*) as num_hours
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE station_id = 15
AND datetime >= '2025-01-20 00:00:00'
AND datetime < '2025-01-25 00:00:00'
"""
weekday_result = pd.read_sql(text(weekday_query), engine)
print("Weekday period (Jan 20-24):")
print(weekday_result)

# Weekend period: 2025-01-25 00:00 to 2025-01-27 00:00 (exclusive)
weekend_query = """
SELECT AVG(aqhi) as avg_aqhi, COUNT(*) as num_hours
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE station_id = 15
AND datetime >= '2025-01-25 00:00:00'
AND datetime < '2025-01-27 00:00:00'
"""
weekend_result = pd.read_sql(text(weekend_query), engine)
print("\nWeekend period (Jan 25-26):")
print(weekend_result)

# Store results in new variables
weekday_mean_aqhi_computed = float(weekday_result['avg_aqhi'].values[0])
weekend_mean_aqhi_computed = float(weekend_result['avg_aqhi'].values[0])
weekday_hour_count = int(weekday_result['num_hours'].values[0])
weekend_hour_count = int(weekend_result['num_hours'].values[0])

print(f"\nWeekday mean AQHI: {weekday_mean_aqhi_computed}")
print(f"Weekend mean AQHI: {weekend_mean_aqhi_computed}")
print(f"Weekday hours: {weekday_hour_count}")
print(f"Weekend hours: {weekend_hour_count}")

# Store the computed results in the required variables
weekday_mean_aqhi = weekday_mean_aqhi_computed
weekend_mean_aqhi = weekend_mean_aqhi_computed

print(f"Stored weekday_mean_aqhi: {weekday_mean_aqhi}")
print(f"Stored weekend_mean_aqhi: {weekend_mean_aqhi}")

# Reuse the already computed values from upstream agents
weekday_mean_aqhi = weekday_mean_aqhi_computed
weekend_mean_aqhi = weekend_mean_aqhi_computed

# Print the results for verification
print(f"Weekday mean AQHI (2025-01-20 to 2025-01-24): {weekday_mean_aqhi}")
print(f"Weekend mean AQHI (2025-01-25 to 2025-01-26): {weekend_mean_aqhi}")
print(f"Difference (Weekday - Weekend): {weekday_mean_aqhi - weekend_mean_aqhi}")

# Verify the variables are correctly assigned
print(f"weekday_mean_aqhi: {weekday_mean_aqhi} (type: {type(weekday_mean_aqhi).__name__})")
print(f"weekend_mean_aqhi: {weekend_mean_aqhi} (type: {type(weekend_mean_aqhi).__name__})")

# Final comparison summary
print(f"\nComparison at Central/Western station (station_id 15):")
print(f"Weekday mean AQHI (Jan 20-24, 2025): {weekday_mean_aqhi:.4f}")
print(f"Weekend mean AQHI (Jan 25-26, 2025): {weekend_mean_aqhi:.4f}")
print(f"Absolute difference: {abs(weekday_mean_aqhi - weekend_mean_aqhi):.4f}")
print(f"Weekday is {((weekday_mean_aqhi - weekend_mean_aqhi) / weekend_mean_aqhi * 100):.1f}% higher than weekend")
